seo.title: Realtor.com: AI natural-language home search with image analysis (2025)
seo.meta_description: Realtor.com deployed in 2025 a natural-language search that recognizes more than 300 terms and analyzes listing photos.
seo.resume_citable: Realtor.com deployed in October 2025 a natural-language home search that recognizes more than 300 terms and analyzes listing photos, then launched RealAssist AI built with Google Gemini in June 2026.

faq.q: How does Realtor.com's AI search work?
faq.a: The user phrases their search the way they speak; the system recognizes more than three hundred terms, analyzes listing photos, and learns from behavior to personalize the results.
A conversational search experience launched in beta in June 2026, built with Google Gemini and Google Cloud, that guides the buyer from budget to being connected with a local agent.

pattern: natural-language search with understanding of listing images

stack_technique.detail: Models for the RealAssist AI conversational search (understanding the need, preference memory).
Cloud platform on which RealAssist AI is built.
Voice and text natural-language search that recognizes more than 300 terms and learns from user behavior.
Understanding of listing photos to surface properties matching the stated criteria; the exact vision model is not named.

objectif_business: Let the buyer phrase their search the way they speak, including complex criteria, and match their words to listing descriptions and photos to bring them faster toward a property and an agent.
description: Realtor.com deploys in October 2025 a voice and text natural-language search that interprets complex queries, for example a single-story house with a pool in a given city and less than five years old. It also analyzes listing photos to surface matching properties, recognizes more than three hundred terms such as cathedral ceilings or a modern kitchen, and learns from the user's behavior to personalize the results. In June 2026, Realtor.com launches RealAssist AI, a conversational search experience built with Google Gemini and Google Cloud, available in beta to a group of logged-in users on desktop, app, and mobile web. RealAssist guides the buyer from their first budget questions through to being connected with a local agent, remembering preferences from one session to the next.

resultats.metrique: Terms recognized by the NL search

niveau_preuve.justification: Specialist press (HousingWire, Real Estate News) and an official Google Cloud release (T2) concordant on the deployment, with quantified feature characteristics. No isolated public engagement metric, hence a C level.

fonctionnement_operationnel.cadence: Real-time on each query; preference memory across sessions for RealAssist.
fonctionnement_operationnel.opere_par: Realtor.com's product and AI team, with Google Cloud as the model provider for RealAssist.
fonctionnement_operationnel.signal_pilote: The richness of listings in text and images, plus user behavior. Without usable descriptions and photos, matching on precise terms degrades.

etapes.detail: The user phrases their search the way they speak, including complex criteria.
The system recognizes more than three hundred terms and analyzes listing photos to find matching properties.
It learns from behavior and, with RealAssist, retains preferences from one session to the next.
RealAssist guides from budget through to being connected with a local agent.

prerequis_data: listings with rich descriptions and photos
prerequis_orga: AI team or cloud partner for the models
computer vision capability on the photos
replication.premiere_etape: Enrich and normalize listing vocabulary before connecting image understanding.

playbook.action: Normalize listing descriptions and build the reference of real-estate terms for the target market.
playbook.livrable: Structured vocabulary mapped to the listing inventory.

playbook.action: Connect natural-language query understanding to the existing search engine.
playbook.livrable: Internal beta of NL search on textual criteria.

playbook.action: Index listing photos with a vision model to cover visual criteria (pool, single-story, modern kitchen).
playbook.livrable: Image-to-criteria index connected to the search.

playbook.action: Open a user beta and add personalization by learning from behavior.
playbook.livrable: Public beta with search engagement measurement.

playbook.action: Link the search to being connected with an agent and generalize.
playbook.livrable: Complete query-to-property-to-agent journey, with a relevance dashboard.

replication.equipe: 1 PM + 2-4 search / ML engineers + 1 data engineer for the listings pipeline + cloud partner for the models.

statut_vivant.note: The NL search has been in production since October 2025 and evolved into RealAssist AI in June 2026, a sign of continued investment in the AI search block.

transposable_ue.note: Natural-language search with listing image analysis is transposable to a European portal. The adaptation concerns language, local real-estate vocabulary, and GDPR on learning from user behavior.
